question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/960789204a2567856547c340e486ddcd23eba4dc792167c9daaae2bd2a9b7703.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is as:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbols move as shown below and M changes into F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd1ed7f48bd7f9e34a5678f57be3257bdc30731ced8f2ef9ed73e9f5b236272.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbols move as shown below and P changes into the triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af2fe6e1641ea39176214ad8b5c065a1398ed3277fab8ce14aff178c127ab16b.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The symbols move as shown below and S changes into the rectangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59361cd9c690351315c1215b54f7da807d43a0e61134e601fea762a43b4b260c.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):**

The symbols move as shown below and F changes into V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65b5a961ec20a8de3f5a8f530d25664d7e0336528387e1bdaa52e0f8360a6760.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
